title: The Bridge of the Lower Danube
author: Beatrix Whitlock
blurb: Petra Okonkwo, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
